name: Lisa's Bedroom
description: A small, neat bedroom with a single bed, a wardrobe, and a vanity mirror. A framed photo of a mountain landscape hangs on the wall. A yoga mat is rolled up in the corner.

items.name: Journal
items.description: A personal journal on the nightstand. The cover is worn from frequent use.
reveals: Recent entries mention feeling uneasy about Victor's management style and concern about accounting irregularities she noticed at work.

items.name: Yoga Mat
items.description: A purple yoga mat rolled up in the corner. Lisa uses it for morning stretches.

conditions.description: A peaceful, private space. Quiet except for street sounds from outside.
